mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.0% signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 5.0% indicates weakening labor market strength, triggering inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signal robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising), elevated interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (supply index) above 120 indicates robust production growth, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises above 120 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rises in INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate balanced economic expansion, strengthening corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 increase over the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (rising HOUST and GDPC1), heightened demand signals peak growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and GDPC1 increase over the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods.
